data.description:
# Deterministic boot default in harness + guard

**Goal:** Make deterministic fixed-delta boot the *only* path in the test
harness: delete the legacy `setTimeout(150)` real-time boot from
`src/test/gameHarness.ts`, remove (or accept-and-ignore) the `deterministicBoot`
option, clean up the 43 redundant `deterministicBoot: true` call sites, and add
a repo-level guard test so the legacy path cannot return. Removes ~89 s of pure
sleeping and the load-sensitivity it causes (parent AC4 core).

**Deliverables**

- `bootScene()`/`bootCombat()` always use deterministic boot (single
  fixed-delta `game.step` path, `bootDeterministic` becomes the only flow).
- `bootDelay`/`setTimeout(150)` deleted from the harness; the
  `deterministicBoot` option is removed from the public options (or kept as a
  deprecated accepted-and-ignored flag if any caller must not be touched).
- Mechanical sweep removing `deterministicBoot: true` from ~43 call sites in 13
  files (verified counts at planning time); the harness header rewritten to
  document the new contract.
- New guard test (name TBD under `src/test/`, e.g.
  `deterministicBootGuard.test.ts`) that statically scans the harness and call
  sites and fails if any `setTimeout`-based boot or explicit `deterministicBoot`
  pass re-appears.

**Key Files:**

- `src/test/gameHarness.ts` — delete bootDelay, deterministic-only boot
- `src/test/deterministicBootGuard.test.ts` (new; mirrors `src/test/duplicateBodyGuard.ts`)
- `src/scenes/**/*.test.ts`, `src/test/**` — 13 files, 43 call sites to sweep
- `./README.md` § Testing conventions (contract text updated here; consolidation
  in C8)

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC1:** `src/test/gameHarness.ts` contains no `setTimeout`-based boot delay;
  `bootDelay` is deleted and deterministic boot is the single path used by both
  `bootScene` and `bootCombat`.
- **AC2:** The `deterministicBoot` option no longer needs to be passed — callers
  of `bootScene()`/`bootCombat()` boot deterministically by default, and the
  option is removed or documented as accepted-and-ignored (deprecated).
- **AC3:** All redundant `deterministicBoot: true` call sites (43 today) are
  cleaned up, unless a site is covered by a documented per-site reason (none
expected).
- **AC4:** A repo-level guard test asserts the invariant (no real-time boot in
  the harness, no `deterministicBoot` pass) and fails loudly if the legacy path
  returns (parent AC4/AC7).
- **AC5:** The full suite is green after the change with the same test count —
  no test deleted, skipped or `expected fail`-converted to make it pass; no new
  flake work items filed during validation.

**Constraints:** Gym↔game parity (harness is shared infrastructure; no gym scene
may diverge from `PlayScene`). No test deleted or weakened.

**Risky assumptions:** A few suites relying on real-time-drained frames may need
a settle-step tuning after the default flips; mitigation is per-suite
`stepGameUntil`/`scene.tick` fixes, not re-adding sleeps. Document any such fix
on this item.

**References:** Parent AH-0MVF3BESP005ZDAV § Desired change 1, AC4, AC7;
deterministic-boot convention (opt-in today — AH-0MUJK70PU003VLIB; this item
inverts it to the default).
